title: Skeleton retarget regression in Fix Silhouette on Godot 4.4
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4-beta1, 4.4-stable, 4.4.1-stable
- Not reproducible in 4.3-stable, 4.4-dev5, 4.4-dev6, 4.4-dev7

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta1 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900K CPU @ 3.60GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

Good behavior: 4.3-stable and all 4.4-dev builds print the following errors during import and work fine. During import, the following two errors are printed:
```
  ERROR: The target vector can't be zero.
  ERROR: The target vector and up vector can't be parallel to each other.
```
Here is a screenshot of expected behavior from Godot 4.4-dev7
![Screenshot of Godot 4.4-dev7](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe8ded40-be6a-4683-b49e-36a6679572b3)

Bad behavior: However, starting from 4.4-beta1 and newer, I instead get one error and several *warnings* which correspond with the error:
```
  ERROR: The target vector can't be zero.
  WARNING: core/math/basis.cpp:1053 - Target and up vectors are colinear. This is not advised as it may cause unwanted rotation around local Z axis.
  WARNING: core/math/basis.cpp:1053 - Target and up vectors are colinear. This is not advised as it may cause unwanted rotation around local Z axis.
  WARNING: core/math/basis.cpp:1053 - Target and up vectors are colinear. This is not advised as it may cause unwanted rotation around local Z axis.
  WARNING: core/math/basis.cpp:1053 - Target and up vectors are colinear. This is not advised as it may cause unwanted rotation around local Z axis.
  WARNING: core/math/basis.cpp:1053 - Target and up vectors are colinear. This is not advised as it may cause unwanted rotation around local Z axis.
```
Here is a picture of the import as of 4.4-beta1 and newer (taken from 4.4.1-stable):
![Screenshot of Godot 4.4.1-stable showing the issue](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c1d80ffc-37ec-45ba-b7f3-601692fffaf5)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached project.
2. Open addons/renik/sample_models in the filesystem and make a New Inherited Scene from godette.glb
3. Optionally open the advanced importer to confirm the import settings for Skeleton3D include a BoneMap with Fix Silhouette enabled.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[silhouette_fixer.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19886864/silhouette_fixer.zip)
